Common Questions

What should actually live on top of a minimalist nightstand?

Limit the tabletop to three things: a warm lamp, one valet tray for glasses/essentials, and a single phone charger. Move everything else into a drawer or lower basket.

How do you charge a phone cleanly when the outlet is behind the bed?

Use a flat-plug extension cord routed behind the headboard to a single bedside charging dock or anchored edge clip.
